title: PEEF Scholarships 2024–25: Cheque Distribution Notification
text:
Distribution of PEEF Scholarship Cheques

It is notified that the
PEEF scholarship cheques
have arrived in the office. All concerned

PCA students
are advised to visit the
Directorate of Admissions & Financial Aid Division (FAD)

at the
Garden Campus, AWKUM
to collect their respective cheques.
